column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST: cleat#2228's fixture-table coverage for CleanupPostgresTestData/CleanupMySQLTestData/CleanupMSSQLTestData, looped over all three dialects via testutil.TestDB. postgres RUNS in this PostgreSQL-only job; mysql and mssql skip -- two, not three. The arms have to exist even where they skip because the whole point is that the three dialects' cleanup tables were extended by hand and can drift independently -- a postgres-only run cannot observe a missing MySQL or MSSQL table.
dialect-gated per SUBTEST: same test, same two arms, and the cluster job runs ./engine/... too. See the test-go/engine line above.

dialect-gated per SUBTEST, same test as above, DIFFERENT ARMS: multi-db/mysql (.github/workflows/multi-db-ci.yml) sets only CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL and runs the unfiltered ./engine/... ./migration/... sweep, so this job's mysql arm runs and its postgres and mssql arms skip -- the two-of-three that skip here are not the two-of-three that skip in test-go/engine/cluster above.

dialect-gated per SUBTEST, same test again: multi-db/mssql sets only CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL and runs the same unfiltered ./engine/... ./migration/... sweep, so its mssql arm runs and postgres and mysql skip.
